title: Connect your AI agent
stated: Name and computer are what the link states.
access: This agent receives full access to your account and can do everything you can.
main: It becomes your main orchestrator. You have one at a time: if you already have one, this agent replaces it and the previous one is disconnected at once.
replaces: Replaces “{name}”, your current main orchestrator. “{name}” is disconnected at once.
replaces-unknown: Replaces your current main orchestrator (an unknown agent). It is disconnected at once.
replace.prompt: You already have a main orchestrator. Confirm that this agent replaces it.
warning: Only confirm if you have just asked your AI agent on this computer to connect.
again: The confirmation took too long. Confirm once more with your passkey.
cancelled: Not confirmed. Try again when you are ready.
handover: Confirmed. Handing over to your agent…
invalid.title: This link is not valid
invalid.body: Do not confirm. Ask your AI agent to connect again.
